notes.title: A top-heavy world
notes.body: The dark structure widens towards the top and narrows towards the bright central stroke. Its scale is difficult to resolve against the planets.

notes.title: Writing crosses the scene

studyData.intro: An inverted structure and enormous planets make the white title feel like a measuring instrument. Follow the details to compare what is visible, what can be interpreted and what the edition record establishes.

regions.label: White characters cross a cosmic field
regions.summary: Two large white Chinese characters stretch across the middle of the upper scene.
regions.question: Where does the white lettering most clearly interrupt an object behind it?

sections.heading: White title in the image
sections.body: Two large white Chinese characters stretch across the middle of the upper scene. Their clean edges contrast with textured planets and machinery. The lettering overlaps several image areas, so it remains a continuous readable unit while the pictured world changes behind it.

sections.heading: Characters read as words and bright shapes
sections.body: 三体 names the three-body concept and the novel. The title’s strong horizontal strokes also work as a graphic interruption. Compare reading the characters as language with seeing them as bright shapes cutting across an otherwise richly coloured surface.

regions.label: One white stroke reaches downward
regions.summary: A narrow white extension descends from the title along the central axis.
regions.question: Does the stroke make the title feel more like writing, a machine part or a direction?

sections.heading: Descending stroke in the image
sections.body: A narrow white extension descends from the title along the central axis. It travels through darker structure towards the lower scene. Its bright, straight form contrasts with curved planets and the irregular details of the illustrated machine.

sections.heading: A vertical stroke joins words and image
sections.body: The extension ties the words to the image without making their roles identical. It can feel like a pointer, beam or spine, but those are possible readings rather than identified objects. Compare how the composition changes if you cover only this vertical stroke.

regions.label: A broad structure narrows towards the centre
regions.summary: A dark, highly textured structure spans the top and tapers towards the central area.
regions.question: What visual clue makes this structure feel enormous rather than merely close?

sections.heading: Inverted structure in the image
sections.body: A dark, highly textured structure spans the top and tapers towards the central area. Small repeated panels and lights cover its surface. Its outer silhouette widens above and narrows below, reversing the familiar expectation that a heavy object sits on a broad base.

sections.heading: An inverted mass unsettles familiar scale
sections.body: The inverted mass creates a sense of uncertain scale and support. The picture offers no familiar human body as a measuring unit. Compare its size with the planets, but resist turning that comparison into a precise physical measurement or identification.

sections.heading: A fictional encounter across space
sections.body: The rights-provider synopsis links a secret search for extraterrestrial civilisation with messages between Earth and another civilisation. That establishes the novel’s speculative setting. It does not identify every machine or planet in this illustration, nor turn the cover into a scientifically scaled diagram.

regions.label: A bright rim defines a large sphere
regions.summary: A large pink sphere occupies the left-middle area.
regions.question: Which visible arc is enough for you to imagine the rest of the sphere?

sections.heading: Large planet in the image
sections.body: A large pink sphere occupies the left-middle area. A bright rim catches its upper and right edge, while much of the surface remains darker. Jagged foreground forms interrupt the lower outline, making the visible sphere incomplete.

sections.heading: The eye completes a partly hidden sphere
sections.body: The missing lower edge is an occlusion, not evidence that the planet is a flat fragment. Our eye can continue the rounded form behind the foreground. Compare this implied completion with the analytical layer, which retains only the pixels actually visible in the cover.

regions.label: Curved bands pass behind another sphere
regions.summary: A smaller pink sphere sits to the right of the central structure, with pale curved bands extending across the surrounding field.
regions.question: Where do the curved bands seem to pass behind another form?

sections.heading: Rings and small planet in the image
sections.body: A smaller pink sphere sits to the right of the central structure, with pale curved bands extending across the surrounding field. The bands and sphere meet darker foreground shapes near the bottom. Their visible segments suggest different depths without a labelled diagram.

sections.heading: A sweep across the central axis
sections.body: The bands add a sweeping direction to the more vertical central axis. They may suggest planetary rings, but the illustration does not supply astronomical measurements. Their compositional role can be examined without treating the scene as a scientifically scaled model.

regions.label: A tiny pale disc changes the scale
regions.summary: A small pale circular disc appears near the right side of the title.
regions.question: What changes when you compare the small disc with the largest sphere?

sections.heading: Small pale disc in the image
sections.body: A small pale circular disc appears near the right side of the title. It is much simpler and smaller than the large pink planets. Its bright surface remains visible within a comparatively quiet patch of magenta sky.

sections.heading: Different circles suggest different scales
sections.body: The tiny disc introduces another scale of roundness. Comparing several circles can make the scene feel expansive, although apparent size alone cannot tell us distance or true diameter. This is a visual scale cue, not a basis for an astronomical calculation.

regions.label: A dense lower field has its own perspective
regions.summary: The lower part contains dense lines, small illuminated shapes and converging paths.
regions.question: Which line or path most strongly draws you into the lower scene?

sections.heading: Lower landscape in the image
sections.body: The lower part contains dense lines, small illuminated shapes and converging paths. It is much busier than the open areas around the planets. Warm highlights concentrate near the centre while darker forms collect along the sides and horizon-like boundary.

sections.heading: Two routes through a dense scene
sections.body: The convergence can draw attention towards a distant central area, countering the title’s broad horizontal emphasis. Looking from the bottom upward gives a different route through the image than beginning with the large white characters. Try both routes before deciding what dominates.

regions.label: A second white line names the writer
regions.summary: 刘慈欣 著 appears in large white characters below the planets.
regions.question: How can you distinguish title and author through placement before translating either line?

sections.heading: Author line in the image
sections.body: 刘慈欣 著 appears in large white characters below the planets. The name occupies most of the width, while 著 identifies authorship. This line shares the title’s high contrast but is placed against the darker, denser lower scene.

sections.heading: Shared colour, different lettering roles
sections.body: The repeated white links title and author without giving them identical forms. The title has a long graphic extension; the author line remains a more conventional block of text. The exact typefaces or lettering process are not established by this reproduction.

regions.label: A pale band carries a promotional statement
regions.summary: A pale horizontal strip spans the upper structure and carries dark red Chinese wording.
regions.question: How does the pale strip make a small promotional line compete with the illustration?

sections.heading: Award band in the image
sections.body: A pale horizontal strip spans the upper structure and carries dark red Chinese wording. The band cuts across the detailed machinery rather than following its perspective. Its even surface makes the compact characters easier to read against an otherwise busy image.

sections.heading: A 2022 edition carries an award claim
sections.body: The rights-provider listing identifies this image with Chongqing Publishing House’s December 2022 Chinese edition, ISBN 9787229166922. The band’s wording presents the book as a Hugo Award-winning work. The edition record should not be confused with the novel’s first book publication in 2008.

regions.label: An orange disc repeats the title
regions.summary: An orange circular device sits near the lower-right corner.
regions.question: What makes this circle read as a graphic label rather than another planet?

sections.heading: Orange seal in the image
sections.body: An orange circular device sits near the lower-right corner. White title-like strokes cross it, and lighter rings distinguish its edge. Its enclosed roundness echoes the planets, but its flat graphic presentation separates it from the illustrated space scene.

sections.heading: A compact mark echoes the larger circles
sections.body: The device acts like a second, compact identity mark at the end of the cover’s reading route. It repeats a recognisable visual idea rather than adding a new scene. Fine wording at this size is not securely transcribed here, and the disc is not treated as a named award seal.

connections.title: A title crosses the machine
connections.label: Title / structure
connections.text: Clean white strokes cut across the textured dark machinery, and the descending title stroke reinforces its central axis.

connections.title: Circles at different scales
connections.label: Planet / seal
connections.text: The large shaded planet and smaller orange title device both use circles, but one suggests depth while the other reads as a flat graphic label.
